integrations.name: Gemma via Ollama
integrations.note: gemma3:4b full suite run locally: 2 pass / 10 fail, JSON tool mode (no native tool calling in Ollama). A 3-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts, tool calls and final states (reply wording differed). Hosted Gemma 4: see the next entry.

integrations.name: Gemma 4 via the Gemini API
integrations.note: gemma-4-31b-it served by Google's Gemini API (OpenAI-compatible endpoint), native tool calls, reasoning_effort minimal: one unseeded full-suite run on 2026-10-18 gave 8 pass / 3 fail / 1 error. The error is the 180 s turn deadline missed through provider latency, after correct tool calls. 18 HTTP 500s were all recovered by the agent's bounded retry. Not bundled here, and not DigitalOcean.

integrations.name: OpenAI-compatible backend
integrations.note: Local: Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 with qwen3:8b, 2 of 2 cases pass. Hosted: Google's Gemini API OpenAI-compatible endpoint with gemma-4-31b-it, full suite (previous entry). Same code path DigitalOcean inference would use; DigitalOcean itself was not called.

integrations.name: DigitalOcean serverless inference
integrations.note: Blocked: no DigitalOcean model access key exists. Request format checked against DigitalOcean's docs and a local stub; never called.

integrations.name: Sentry agent tracing
integrations.note: Mock only: gen_ai agent, chat and tool spans checked with the real sentry-sdk and an in-memory transport; error events carry no local variables (so no API key or utterance), and model/tool exceptions are captured. No trace has been sent to Sentry: a dedicated BoliBench DSN is still needed.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs speech
integrations.note: Live on 2026-10-18 (free tier, eleven_multilingual_v2 TTS + scribe_v2 STT): TTS, STT, the opt-in live test, the CLI with the audio cache (rerun reused the audio), and 3 cases end to end with local qwen3:8b acting on the transcripts (1 pass / 2 fail; the text-only run of the same cases: 0 / 3). Synthetic voice, n=1 per case: shows the pipeline works, not speech robustness.

integrations.name: MongoDB export (Atlas pending)
integrations.note: Exported 3 bundled runs into a local MongoDB 7.0.45: idempotent re-export, indexes, per-case report, live test passing. Not yet run against an Atlas cluster: needs a dedicated Atlas cluster or user created by the owner.

integrations.name: Tiger Data export + similar-failure search (Tiger Cloud pending)
integrations.note: Local TimescaleDB 2.30.2 + pgvector 0.8.7 (PostgreSQL 16): hypertable export, idempotent, report, 22 failures embedded with local embeddinggemma, hybrid keyword + vector search. Not yet run on Tiger Cloud: needs a dedicated service created by the owner.

integrations.name: Temporal durable evaluation runs
integrations.note: Local Temporal dev server (CLI 1.9.1, Server 1.32.0): same summary as bolibench run; after kill -9 of the worker the interrupted case ran again (attempt 2) and the run completed; restarting the same workflow id re-ran nothing. The agent in the crash test was a slow stub. This makes the evaluation run durable, not the agent. Not run on Temporal Cloud.

integrations.name: Mastra agent
integrations.note: examples/mastra-agent (@mastra/core 1.78.0) full suite on local qwen3:8b: 6 pass / 6 fail / 0 error. A 2-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts and tool calls.

integrations.name: Backboard bridge (partial: paid model blocked by billing)
integrations.note: Partial. Real API on 2026-10-18: auth, model list, assistant/thread and the tool-call round trip work (two bridge bugs found live and fixed); memory isolation between cases checked. The chosen open-weight model (qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507) could not run: the account's free credit does not pay for LLM chat. A zero-priced preview model passed 3 of 4 cases. No full-suite run, and not two models.

integrations.name: Render deploy
integrations.note: Deployed on 2026-10-18 to https://bolibench-demo-1b3o.onrender.com (free plan, Singapore, commit 3440507) with token-gated live mode on: the container runs the example agent on Gemma 4 (gemma-4-31b-it) via Google's Gemini API. Public endpoint checks passed; one hosted live run (cancel-single-order) passed in 35 s. The earlier read-only service is suspended and no longer used.

integrations.note: Blocked: no DigitalOcean credentials. Same Docker image as Render; the spec was checked by hand against the App Spec reference, not with doctl. Not deployed.
